title: lepidanthus suaveolens
intro: Lepidanthus suaveolens, commonly known as Sweet Billy or Sweet Billy Buttons, is a flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. It is used as a medicinal plant, valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Lepidanthus suaveolens include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
